CMOS voltage-window detector
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VB vb 0 0.9
VIN vin 0 0
XDUT vdd 0 vin vb out astra_029_cmos_voltage_window_detector
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec lower range 0.8 1 unit=V
* @spec upper range 2.3 2.5 unit=V
* @spec below range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec inside range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec above range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
dc VIN 0 3.3 0.005
meas dc lower WHEN v(out)=1.65 RISE=1
meas dc upper WHEN v(out)=1.65 FALL=1
meas dc below FIND v(out) AT=0.3
meas dc inside FIND v(out) AT=1.65
meas dc above FIND v(out) AT=3.0
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
